# Lucachinou (Luca)

> 17-year-old French student learning AI to become an AI Engineer.
> Builds open-source projects: Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), server administration tools and bots.
> Main languages: Python, Rust and Java.

## Profile

- **Name**: Luca, known online as **Lucachinou**
- **Age**: 17 (born in 2009)
- **Nationality**: French
- **Role**: studying AI to become an AI Engineer, open-source contributor
- **Focus**: AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP
- **Languages spoken**: French, English
- **Website**: https://lucachinou.github.io/ (available in English and French)

## Skills

- **Python** (main language): Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), automation, AI, bots
- **Java**: plugins and mods for Minecraft, back-end
- **JavaScript**: Discord bots (Node.js) and lightweight web interfaces
- **Rust**: system tools and performance

## Projects

Luca currently has no single main project; his public projects are:

- [Assistant](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Assistant) (Beta): source code of the AI
  assistant available on his portfolio. Built in Python with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented
  Generation) and Machine Learning.
- [Singlecraft](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Singlecraft) (Beta): open-source web
  dashboard in Python for managing Minecraft servers: start, stop, restart and view
  live logs. Designed to be easy to use.

## Portfolio website

- **Sections**: Home, Projects, Skills, About
- **AI Assistant**: a built-in chat assistant (bottom-right button) answers questions
  about Luca, his projects and his stack.
- **Articles**: coming soon.
- **Languages**: English (default) and French, switchable from the header.

## FAQ

- **Who is Lucachinou?** Luca, a 17-year-old French student learning AI to become an
  AI Engineer. He works on machine learning with PyTorch, TensorFlow and SpaCy and
  publishes his projects as open source on GitHub.
- **What is he working on?** The Assistant (RAG-based AI assistant for his portfolio)
  and Singlecraft (Minecraft server dashboard).
- **Which languages does he use?** Python for ML/AI and automation, Java for Minecraft
  plugins and mods, JavaScript for Discord bots and web interfaces, Rust for system tools.
